clips.title: The story
paras: Near Zoram Strand, The Ancient Statuette lies lost after a naga attack. Talen, an elf camped on the northwestern coast of Ashenvale, needs you to recover the relic he dropped in the surf.

Naga attacked Talen as he steered a small vessel through the shallows by Zoram's sunken ruins on Ashenvale's northwestern shore. He scrambled ashore with only bare provisions and made a hasty camp. In his desperate flight, he dropped the ancient statuette he had found among the ruins into the sands.

Talen braved the naga-infested Zoram Strand for the ancient statuette. Once you return it, he explains that the drowned city holds centuries of forgotten mysteries. He believes the delicate carving is a key to understanding what remains hidden beneath the tides.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I would charge you with a task, friend.

I was on my small vessel, skimming over the submerged ruins of Zoram, when naga attacked me, surging from the water and tearing at me with their claws! I fled, carrying what supplies I could to make this meager camp.
But when I reached the shore and ran... My prized possession was lost.
Please, friend, find the site of my ambush, along the coast to the north, and search for an ancient statuette. It is the reason I have braved the dangers of the Zoram Strand.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you found the statuette, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You found it! Thank you, friend!
The old city of Zoram holds many secrets, and this statuette may be the key to many of them.
